name: Bit-order probe
description: Product state with X on qubit 0 and Ry(0.1 + 0.35*k/n) half-turns on qubit k >= 1, so every qubit has a different |1> probability (all below 0.5 except qubit 0, which is 1). A backend that reverses or permutes bit order disagrees with the rest, which symmetric circuits such as Bell or GHZ cannot reveal.
code:
if n_qubits < 2:
    raise ValueError("Bit-order probe requires at least 2 qubits.")

circ = Circuit(n_qubits)
circ.X(0)
for q in range(1, n_qubits):
    circ.Ry(round(0.1 + 0.35 * q / n_qubits, 6), q)

qasm = circuit_to_qasm_str(circ)
